snapshotContract.secrets: Presence is represented only by configured=true and a sha256 reference; secret values are forbidden.
snapshotContract.bindings: Each required service binding carries only its name, type=service, and a distinct sha256 target reference.
snapshotContract.receipts: The deployed version must equal the digest recomputed from reviewed Worker runtime sources; rollback is a distinct sha256 reference; the full canonical snapshot must match a separately owner-approved configuration digest.
snapshotContract.output: The checker emits field labels and verdicts, never configuration values.
